title: Trigonometry
overview: A focused revision guide to trigonometry.

sections.title: Exact values
content: Know sin/cos/tan for 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90° without a calculator.

sections.title: Key identities
bullets: Graphs of sin, cos and tan — know period, amplitude and key features

examTips: When solving "for 0 ≤ x ≤ 360°", find all solutions in range — sketch the graph or use a CAST diagram to check you haven't missed one.
